scope:
Complete MSA compact bridge candidate; original 866 FF/history bits retained.

Only the implementation bridge registers change. Original address latch
equations remain byte-identical; a pure combinational output predicts actual
row/column changes on the next guest edge. Native transport/schema is separate.

frontend_manifest.scope:
Experimental native nondeferred frontend without duplicate transaction buffers.

Required contract: advance only when every group is ready; addr_will_change
predicts the address-register update on that guest edge. Address/write_data
therefore stay stable for each accepted raw transaction. The cache commits a
completed write AFTER the guest has sampled the old word. All actual registers
are exported; a new schema is required. No native integration is implied.
frontend_manifest.state_relation: cache_valid=reference.hit; cache_data=reference.read_value; eight other fields equal; no old snapshot-schema compatibility
